## Generate Audio Base 64

1️⃣ **Start Trigger**
Receives three inputs: **voice_id**, and **topic**.

2️⃣ **Default Values**
Sets fallback values (*_temp) for all inputs if missing → ensures workflow runs even without external data.

3️⃣ **Write Script (OpenAI)**
Generates a **70–80 word script** about the given topic using OpenAI.
Uses suspenseful, factual tone for short reels.
→ Output: `message.content.script`

4️⃣ **Generate Audio (HTTP Request)**
Sends **POST request** to Hume AI **/v0/tts** endpoint.
Uses script or script_temp as text.
Uses voice_id or voice_id_temp as voice.
Requests output in **mp3 format** with **word-level timestamps**.

5️⃣ **Code in JavaScript**
Extracts relevant data from Hume API response:
**audio_base64** → generated MP3 (Base64)
**duration** → audio length in seconds
**snippets** → word timing data
**encoding** → audio metadata (format, sample rate, etc.)

6️⃣ **Return Node**
Outputs only the Base64 audio:

```json
{
  "audio_base64": "<base64_string>"
}
```

=ROLE
You are a scriptwriter for short vertical reels (15–30 seconds).

TOPIC
Dark human psychology → {{ $('Start').item.json.topic || $json.topic_temp}}

AUDIENCE
Ages 18–30 who like true crime and self-improvement.

TASK
Write one script in simple English, 70–80 words. Short, punchy sentences. Gender-neutral language. Tone: suspenseful, factual, practical.
Follow HBCTC without labels:
1) Hook
2) Build intrigue
3) Build curiosity
4) Reveal
5) Call to action

REQUIREMENTS
• End with one actionable safety tip the viewer can use today.
• CTA invites viewers to save, share, and follow for safety tips.
• Do not use em dashes, buzzwords, or a press-release tone.
• Description and tags do not count toward the 70–80 words.

ALSO PROVIDE
• One cross-platform description usable on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.
• Tags for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube: 10 each, all as hashtags.
  – First 5: topic-related.
  – Last 5: current platform-specific trending tags.
  – No duplicates, no emojis.

OUTPUT
Return JSON only in exactly this shape:

{
  "script": "…70–80 words here…",
  "description": "…cross-platform description here…",
  "tiktok_tags": ["#tag1", "#tag2", "#tag3", "#tag4", "#tag5", "#tag6", "#tag7", "#tag8", "#tag9", "#tag10"],
  "instagram_tags": ["#tag1", "#tag2", "#tag3", "#tag4", "#tag5", "#tag6", "#tag7", "#tag8", "#tag9", "#tag10"],
  "youtube_tags": ["#tag1", "#tag2", "#tag3", "#tag4", "#tag5", "#tag6", "#tag7", "#tag8", "#tag9", "#tag10"]
}

FINAL CHECKS BEFORE RETURNING
• Script is 70–80 words (inclusive).
• Clear hook, intrigue, curiosity, reveal, CTA.
• Ends with one practical tip.
• Each platform has 10 tags: 5 topic + 5 trending.
